description: Land Acquisition - Thalapitiya, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1646/14 of 23.03.2010 by Wattala D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes.
